subject: VaultPay security controls recap + evidence & next-step sprint
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@vaultpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: VaultPay security controls recap + evidence & next-step sprint
Attachments: SOC2-QuickSummary-2028.pdf; audit-log-sample-30days.csv; DPA-draft-v2.docx

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and Samir on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and timing.

TL;DR
- Primary ask: VaultPay needs a reproducible evidence bundle for security review (SOC 2 alignment, audit logs, retention policy, and pen test results) to clear procurement and legal.
- Proposed sprint: 2-week artifact collection + 1-week review with your security team.

Pain points we heard
1) Audit log retention: you need 12 months of immutable audit logs across API and admin console, exported in CSV/JSON for your auditors.
2) DPA & data residency: your legal team requires a DPA that calls out 30/60/90-day retention tiers and a vendor-side deletion workflow.
3) SOC 2 artifacts: you prefer a short-form SOC 2 quick summary for initial review rather than full report, plus sample control evidence.
4) Pen test: you want a latest pentest summary and confirmed remediation list for any high/critical findings.

What Redwood will provide (proposed)
- SOC2-QuickSummary-2028.pdf (high-level control mapping + scope) — attached.
- audit-log-sample-30days.csv (an export showing fields, retention markers, immutability flag) — attached.
- DPA-draft-v2.docx (Redwood's baseline DPA with optional retention clauses) — attached.
- Pen test: summary + remediation notes (we'll pull the redacted summary and timeline).

Asks for VaultPay (please share by Jul 16)
- Confirm legal point of contact for DPA redlines (name & email).
- Share any required audit-log schema fields we must include beyond timestamp, user_id, action, ip, request_id.
- Confirm whether logs must be stored in-region (we noted US region requirement).

Proposed timeline / owners
- By Jul 12 (Rishi/Redwood): Send initial artifacts (attached).
- By Jul 16 (VaultPay): Return DPA redline comments + confirm retention schema.
- Jul 17–21 (Joint): Evidence sprint — exchange artifacts, Redwood provides pen test summary and additional logs as requested.
- Week of Jul 24: Final alignment call with procurement/legal.

Next immediate step
- Olivia/Samir: please confirm the DPA reviewer and a preferred time for a 30-minute follow-up on Jul 18–20.

Notes on sensitive items
- We will provide redacted pen-test details; full reports can be shared under an NDA if required.
- Audit log exports will include hashed PII where applicable; we can provide procedures for pulling identifiers for auditors under a scoped process.

Thanks again — looping Marissa and Karthik for technical follow-up (KV cache snapshots, retention config, and access logs).

Cheers,
Rishi
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
(Attachment stubs: SOC2-QuickSummary-2028.pdf [12 pages], audit-log-sample-30days.csv [CSV], DPA-draft-v2.docx [Word])

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@vaultpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@vaultpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VaultPay security controls recap + evidence & next-step sprint
Attachments: vaultpay-retention-policy.pdf

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap and for the artifacts. Samir and I reviewed briefly and this direction looks good. A few clarifications: 

1) DPA reviewer: our lead counsel is Olivia Legal (olivia.legal@vaultpay.com) — I'll intro by EOD tomorrow and ask for high-level redline guidance.
2) Audit log schema: in addition to the fields you listed, we need: service_name, tenant_id, event_hash, and a signed-timestamp marker for immutability. See attached (vaultpay-retention-policy.pdf) for our internal expectations.
3) Pen test: we'll need the CVSS scores and remediation dates for medium+ findings; NDA is fine for the full report.
4) In-region: yes, logs must be stored in US-EAST for the first 90 days, then lifecycle to encrypted cold storage is acceptable.

We're aiming to have the DPA reviewer comments back by Jul 16 as you requested. Jul 18–20 follow-up windows look good — we'll propose times after I intro legal.

One logistical ask: can Redwood provide a short audit playbook (3–4 steps) for our auditors to validate logs? That would speed our internal review.

Thanks — Olivia
Director, Security Operations
VaultPay
(Attachment stub: vaultpay-retention-policy.pdf [4 pages])

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Internal note — pulling together next steps based on Olivia's reply. Posting here so we have a clear owner list.

Action items
- Marissa: prepare a one-page "audit playbook" (3–4 verification steps + sample queries) — due Jul 14. Reference: audit-log-sample-30days.csv.
- Karthik: produce the redacted pen-test summary with CVSS scores and remediation dates; confirm what requires NDA for full report — due Jul 15.
- Rishi: intro to Olivia Legal and push HubSpot deal notes (DEAL-4387-US); confirm DocuSign path if they want signed DPA before sprint — due Jul 11.
- Olivia/Samir: confirm DPA reviewer contact and return redlines by Jul 16.

I'll also upload the artifacts to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-sec-evidence and add a HubSpot task for the follow-up call: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4387

If you want to split the pen-test task (Karthik + Security team), flag it here and I'll loop in Camille.

Thanks — Rishi
